market_context: US equity futures and ETF pre-market prices are sharply lower on Wednesday after hot October PCE inflation and reports of new Trump tariffs raised rate-hike and growth concerns (cnbc.com, finance.yahoo.com). The AI and semiconductor selloff is pressuring QQQ, while VIX is spiking ahead of the Thanksgiving market closure (wallstreetbets.com, finance.yahoo.com).

predictions.reasoning: S&P 500 futures were down about 1.9% and SPY pre-market was shown lower by roughly 1.94% to 2.10% after core PCE rose 3.3% year over year and headline PCE rose 3.8% ([cnbc.com, wallstreetbets.com). With new tariff headlines and VIX spiking, SPY is likely to close below the baseline near the pre-market implied level.

Nasdaq-100 futures fell 2.8% to 3% and QQQ pre-market was down about 2.9% to 3.2% as Nvidia, Micron and other AI-linked stocks extended losses (finance.yahoo.com, stocktitan.net). The hotter-than-forecast core PCE reading reinforces December rate-hike expectations, keeping pressure on high-multiple tech into the close (cnbc.com).

Dow futures declined about 1.3% and DIA pre-market fell roughly 1.34%, showing that Tuesday's strength in value names is fading (wallstreetbets.com, finance.yahoo.com). Tariff uncertainty and sticky inflation should keep broad risk appetite weak, so DIA should finish below its prior close.
